relationships.reason: Understanding supply and demand choices requires foundational knowledge of scarcity and opportunity cost.
Elasticity measures the responsiveness of quantity demanded or supplied to price changes, requiring a prior grasp of market supply and demand.
Understanding externalities requires knowledge of standard market equilibrium to evaluate market failure and uncompensated social costs.
Economic development is defined in contrast to and broader than national aggregate measures like Gross Domestic Product.
Fiscal policy aims to influence aggregate economic activity, which is quantified by metrics like GDP.
Monetary policy regulates financial conditions primarily to control inflation and maintain price stability.
